svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut five lengths of 90 mm pipe (for sockets 45 mm deep; adjust

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each by the difference if your fittings differ):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: P1 tee branch to first elbow, 275 mm; P2 long run, 970 mm;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: P3 short drop, 135 mm; P4 last elbow to jet 1 coupling, 100 mm;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: P5 reducer to jet 2 coupling, 110 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Penstock enters the 125 mm run of the tee; the run's other end takes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 125 x 90 reducer and P5 to jet 2. The 90 mm side branch takes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: P1, then elbows and P2, P3, P4 round the housing to jet 1.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dry fit everything on the stands first. Then solvent weld the PVC

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: joints, one at a time, keeping the elbows square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flexible couplings join P4 and P5 to the nozzle spigots; band clamps

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: snug, not crushed. Do not glue the nozzles.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: centre line 338 mm above the pad all round.
